title: Update Contract Compatibility and Authoritative ONVIF Configuration Truth
summary: Strengthens update entry and Compose identity handoff across supported legacy and current contracts, and makes ONVIF encoder configuration read, apply and verification truthful with localized operator errors.
changelog: Normalizes terminal and in-app update entry around one exact Compose project identity without guessed product fallbacks.
Preserves stable bootstrap, active-slot and runtime authority while handing supported legacy and current update contracts to the exact target implementation.
Adds a canonical cumulative adopted-development owner so working-NAS validation builds only the affected services without creating a second deployment model.
Reads ONVIF encoder current values and supported options across real Dahua and Zeep response shapes without inventing unsupported capabilities.
Applies only changed supported encoder fields, rereads the camera and returns a typed mismatch instead of reporting an unverified success.
Adds camera-health configuration truth and localized RU, EN and ZH-CN presentation for ONVIF configuration failures.
Adds byte-exact published 0.8.15 terminal and in-app entry regressions for the next release boundary without changing immutable historical code.
